notes: All three pages use the same label patterns for asking_price, revenue, and cash_flow inside paragraph elements. The values appear to be blank/not disclosed on these sold listings but the labels are consistent. City and state are combined in a single 'div.city-state' element (e.g. 'Burr Ridge , IL') and must be parsed/split from that single element; there is no separate element for each. The cash_flow field uses 'Net Operating Income' as the label, which may not be true SDE/cash flow but is the only income metric shown on the page.
